Class FxUtil

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.view.gui.FxUtil
public final class FxUtil extends Object
Small JavaFX helpers shared by the game-screen sub-views: the selection glow, the disabled-card darken filter, the card-pile shadow, and image loaders that swallow failures so a missing asset never crashes a render. Kept in one place so GameScreen and its renderers (BoardRenderer, PlayerPanelsRenderer, …) all draw with the same effects.
